name: lyrique
description: Synced, pretty lyrics for YouTube Music playing in your browser — a macOS desktop app.
author: Mynt

scripts.dist:local: electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:release: electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: electron-vite build && ELECTRON_BUILDER_7Z_FILTER=BCJ electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
